status: First pass, 18 October 2026. Game-balance numbers of the enemy air command (simcore/air_war/; docs/air_war/). Not system data.
source: game value: tuned by sam3d against the shapes in docs/research/ENEMY_AIR_RESEARCH_2026-10.md (staleness of mobile targets: wiki_model5; EMCON against ARMs: wiki_black_buck, vr_1985_plss; inflated claims: afmag_2000_kosovo, design reference only)
notes: Every key here is read by simcore/air_war (TuningTable::Defaults lists them with their defaults; an unknown key fails the load). Chances are per aircraft per pass unless said otherwise.

utility.notes: The planner's utility: value_weight x worth x chance it is there and works x chance of delivery x effect, minus loss_cost x expected losses x loss aversion (which grows as the faction's daily loss tolerance shrinks), plus quirk_scale x habits, minus the memory of losses that way, plus exploration x creativity / sqrt(1 + uses), plus noise that shrinks with planning skill. Packages below min_value are not flown. A cruise missile salvo has no crew to lose: missile_cost per missile spent, times the square root of how many times scarcer the stock has become than at the start (game value, the nation on the map N4, 23 Oct 2026). sortie_cost: per aircraft in a strike, DEAD or close-support package; above zero the planner weighs a pair, the template's group and a doubled one against each other (docs/air_war/13_PACKAGES.md): 0.1 sizes the groups to the target (a sweep of 0.05, 0.15 and 0.3 gave the Pact 7.9, 6.1 and 4.3 attackers a package, NATO 5.6, 4.9 and 4.1; docs/air_war/09_BALANCE.md section 10).

attrition.notes: low_vs_long_range_sam: a low flier is masked from a long-range SAM's radar (radius above 15 km) for most of a pass (Dugman 5's low approach traded SAMs for guns: wiki_model5). sead_suppression with two or more SEAD aircraft, scaled by the SEAD officer's skill and the package's coordination. night and poor_weather apply to optical defences. emcon_lethality: a SAM fighting silent (TV, the PU-12's designations) engages late. arm_kill_no_memory_off: an ARM without memory against a radar that switched off in time (wiki_black_buck); arm_kill_memory_off: one with a memory of where the radar was, which still misses most radars that radiate for seconds and move (Allied Force: some 743 HARMs, 3 of about 25 SA-6 batteries confirmed destroyed, rand_mr1365; calibrated in docs/air_war/09_BALANCE.md section 9). pass_scale: every defence's lethality is a relative one, times this for the chance per aircraft on a pass through the heart of its zone (calibrated against the period's losses in docs/air_war/09_BALANCE.md section 9: the 1973 belt, the Bekaa, Desert Storm's low against medium altitude). decoy_exposure: a radar that fired at decoys is suppressed at least this much by the SEAD behind them (the Bekaa, 1982). sead_suppression raised from 0.45 to 0.6 by the same calibration. An ARM's hit takes out one fire-control radar (an Osa battery has four). target_guns_troops and target_guns_site: light guns and shoulder-fired missiles around a target without its own air defence, per aircraft attacking it low or by helicopter (Dugman 5: most aircraft were hit by guns at the low approach height, wiki_model5); troops carry the most.

strike.notes: stale_miss_m: the aim point must be within this of the real target, or the bombs fall on empty ground (a battery that moved). decoy_area_m: a dummy this close to the aim point takes the bombs. collateral_m: bombs aimed this close to a town's edge risk civilian casualties.

delivery.notes: The weapons model (docs/air_war/10_WEAPONS.md). cep_*_m: the circular error of an unguided weapon by its attack, for a sight of middling quality (times 1.4 - 0.8 x the type's computing) and an average crew (times 1.25 - 0.5 x airmanship); the level figure is the Vietnam-era average miss (420-447 ft, afmag_2003_bombs), the guided ones the early Paveway (20 ft) and the TV seeker's ideal (wiki_lgb); the rest game values. night_visual_factor: a dive or pop-up by eye at night without a night attack system. cloudy_laser: the chance the laser spot holds under cloud. exposure_*: the share of the target's own guns and shoulder-fired missiles the attack meets (a laydown overflies them; a loft turns away some km short, saaf_toss; medium altitude is above them, rand_mr1365's 15,000 ft floor). release_*_m: how far short of the target the weapons go (a stand-off weapon at its own range). runway_strip_m: a crater anywhere this near the aim across the runway cuts it (about half a main runway's width), so a runway bomb's footprint is at least this. footprint_soft and footprint_light: a bomb's footprint against people, trucks and stores, and against light vehicles, radars and guns, times its footprint against armour and concrete (blast and fragments; game values). strafe and gentle_dive (roadmap B6): a gun pass opens fire at release_strafe_m (the 1,115 m mean slant of cdat_array20_1980) in a shallow dive; a rocket salvo from a 10-25 degree dive (mt_1970_bukhantsev) pulls up gentle_dive_pull_m short to gentle_dive_apex_m and fires by gentle_dive_release_m above the ground. The attack profiles the routes fly: a pop-up pulls up popup_pull_m short of the target, climbs to popup_apex_m above the ground and releases in its dive at popup_release_m; a toss pulls up loft_pull_m out (4-5 nm, saaf_toss) and releases climbing at loft_release_m; a dive rolls in dive_roll_in_m short from its medium height and releases at dive_release_m (the MiG-27's level, dive and toss deliveries: mig27_book); a helicopter fires from the hover at hover_agl_m (game values). All game values, calibrated in docs/air_war/09_BALANCE.md section 9.

radio.source: nsa_purple_dragon_1993 pp. 22-26 (the two ends of the hours warning: 34 % of strikes alerted with 8.5 h of warning, then 5 % with under 30 min), pp. 68-69 (new call signs and codes broken out in as little as six hours); osipov_2013; fm_100_2_1_1984 p. 15-2 (df_sigma_deg: VHF direction finding usually within 3.5 degrees); vr_1989_tr1 (the radio horizon R = 4.12 sqrt(H) behind abstract_range_m and the abstract hearing); vr_1985_plss, nazarenko_1984 (our dummy traffic, the enemy radio demonstration); game values for the rest
radio.notes: The enemy's radio (docs/air_battle/09_COMMS_AND_INTERCEPT.md). call_*_s: a call's length by kind, the middle of section 2.2's range, longer by stress_repeat at full stress (a stressed pilot's calls are longer and said again); stale_*_s: a call older than its use is dropped (section 2.5); signal_*: a silent flight's act passed by signal reaches only those who see the leader, a half longer than a call; vector_hold_s: a GCI channel stays with a group this long after its last vector (section 2.6); continuity_tau_h: continuity 1 - exp(-hours heard / tau) gives 0.8 after about 6 h of steady traffic, and it restarts from 0 at a call sign change; continuity_name_at: from here the analysts name the unit; opsec_*: the staff's opsec 0..1 maps in a straight line from the careless end to the careful end (a SAM3D game value between PURPLE DRAGON's ends); opsec_loose_lips: opsec lost to a planner with the comsec_leak quirk; discipline_*: how loose lips and the chatterbox or silent runner move radio discipline (at most about 0.2, the brief's decision 9); abstract_calls: the calls an abstract package's flight makes on its way, rolled in closed form (section 2.4). Roadmap S6: mode 1 turns on the abstract packages' calls heard by our posts into the campaign's pipeline (the day summary), the intercept facts of played sessions rebuilt from the save, the enemy's listeners placed on the campaign's radio, our dummy corridors and the Teaball relay where a faction has one (0: before S6; a save without radio_mode replays at 0); abstract_hear: the chance an abstract call in reach is logged (a fade, a busy operator); abstract_range_m: no air set heard beyond about the E-3A's horizon; abstract_hf_range_m: the HF request net's reach (no horizon); abstract_mast_m: an enemy ground post's antenna; awacs_height_m: an airborne post's orbit; our_dummy_corridors: false corridors a day our GCI and notices talk on, turned our_dummy_turn_deg from a real one about its airfield; our_dummy_period_s and our_dummy_mast_m: a session's dummy transmitter in a false corridor calls this often from a mast this high at its middle; mode 2 (S6's follow-ups): the radio's draws keyed on strings alike on every compiler, a squadron's fit and codeword alike in a session and the campaign, and a played session's word on whether the enemy heard our dummy traffic; demonstration_quirk: a feint artist or decoy man adds this to his faction's radio demonstration share (all game values but df_sigma_deg).

support.notes: The support aircraft (docs/air_war/11_SUPPORT.md). sorties_per_aircraft_day: what one support aircraft flies a day. An orbit kept round the clock takes awacs_sorties_per_orbit_day sorties of an AWACS (8-hour stations) and elint_sorties_per_orbit_day of an ELINT aircraft. receivers_per_tanker_sortie: Desert Storm's average was about 4.2 (215 KC-135 and 35 KC-10 sorties a day refuelled 1,061 aircraft, gwaps_vol3 Table 16). awacs_fighter_cut: the share of the defender's fighter chance an AWACS on station takes away (warning and vectoring for the escorts; game value). elint_reach_without and elint_sigma_without: the ELINT picture without an ELINT aircraft up, its reach and its error against one (game values). low_radius_share: the combat radius flown low against the type's published (lo-lo-lo against hi-lo-hi); refuelled_radius: with a tanker on the way (game values).

logistics.notes: Our supply lines (docs/air_war/14_LOGISTICS.md). consumption_per_day: a formation in the field uses a third of its stocks a day (three days of supply); once they are out it loses unsupplied_decay_per_day of its strength a day down to unsupplied_floor, and below repair_needs_supply mends nothing. bridge_open: a bridge carries traffic again from this function. snap_m: a depot or the troops this far off the country map's roads or railways reach them on local roads. search_m: an armed reconnaissance searches this far each way of its point along the line; find_*: the chance its pilots see a column on the move there, by day, at dawn or dusk, at night, at night with a night attack system, and times find_poor_weather under low cloud. All game values.

learning.notes: Roadmap S7. mode 1: a flight lost where nobody saw what shot it (no survivor saw the launch, or none came home) makes the staff suspect an air defence where it was last heard of: a report of a suspected defence (exists unexplained_exists, a ring of unexplained_radius_m, lethality unexplained_lethality) at its last reported place with unexplained_sigma_m; and a faction whose sympathisers watch our troops (its intelligence's humint_air_defence_per_day) hears of our mobile air defence, a battery within watch_m of a town as often as its rate gives and one out in the country countryside_share as often (half that under its nets). mode 0: before S7 (a save made before it).

intel.notes: comint_per_call: the chance one radio call of the battery's gives the enemy's direction finders a fix (times the means' intercept share), when our side's information pipeline says what the battery actually said on the air (roadmap P3); without it, the posture's radio discipline stands for the traffic. column_sigma_share: a supply column's believed position spreads at this share of its speed (it may have driven on or stopped). A mobile unit's believed position spreads at mobile_sigma_growth_mps and the belief that it is there halves every mobile_confidence_half_life_h. fixed_function_recovery: how fast the enemy assumes a struck fixed target is repaired (share per 48 h). ghost_fix_chance: an ELINT fix lands between the battery and a dummy whose decoy emitter radiates on its parameters (vr_1985_plss: active dummies). claim_destroy_when_off: pilots report a radar that went silent under ARM attack as destroyed.

adapt.notes: learning_rate is scaled by each officer's rigidity and method. An officer whose reputation falls below relieve_below is relieved; an ambitious one above promote_above is promoted away. reopen_margin: a campaign whose phase ended on the believed air defences goes back to it when they are believed this much above the line again (the rollback resumes when the sites come back).

politics.notes: Pressure from above grows on days without results; support falls with losses beyond the faction's tolerance; prisoners add pressure; civilian casualties widen the no-strike zone around towns (Rolling Thunder's restricted zones: nmusaf_sanctuaries).

repair.notes: Damage is repaired in the field at 1/repair_h of the whole an hour. A wrecked object is out until its replacement comes, repair_h after it was wrecked (a span, a battery from the reserve, new vehicles), and comes back at restored_function; the field repair completes it.

weather.source: crawford_1977_rand (Central Europe below a 5,000 ft ceiling and 5 nmi visibility about 85 % of the time in winter, 50 % in summer); the months between and the poor share of the not-clear days are a game value
weather.notes: Each day's weather is drawn at the start: clear, cloudy or poor. mode 1 (roadmap S7): on a dated theatre the not-clear share is the month's (0.85 December to February, 0.5 June to August, the months between interpolated: simcore/air_war/campaign.hpp NotClearShare) and the poor days the same part of the not-clear ones as clear_share and poor_share give (0.3); mode 0 (a save made before S7): clear_share and poor_share every month.

pacing.notes: Which of the enemy's raids the player flies: those that come within sector_m of the battery (or at it), no closer than min_gap_h apart, at most max_per_day. The rest are resolved abstractly. The pacing chooses; it never adds raids (l4d_director_2007, used only for this).

scenario.notes: A raid as the player's scenario: the flights inside clip_m of the battery, prep_s before the first aircraft appears; the mission bridge's weapon effects (roadmap E6 will replace the ARM with an EM missile).

comms_jam.source: fm_34_40_7 (J/S = (Pj/Pt)(Dt/Dj)^n, K = 2 to capture an FM receiver, n = 3 for rolling farmland); paprcka_1984 (jamming eased a few minutes before the anti-radiation missiles flew); own_power_w is the launchers' R-123M, about 20 W (r123_refs), the weaker side of the battery net; weak_js is a sam3d value
comms_jam.notes: The enemy's jamming of our voice nets (air_war/comms_jamming.hpp, roadmap 16.2).

own_intel.notes: What the player's side learns: a prisoner talks with pow_chance; the warning net gives warning_s before the first aircraft, leak_warning_s when the enemy's planner has loose lips.

c2.notes: Game values of the command in the air (air_war/c2.hpp, track B, B5; docs/air_battle/05_C2_AND_RETASKING.md): mode 1 the posts and the packages flown in time, 0 as before B5 (a save of version 1 replays with it); the campaign's step while a package is airborne (step_h, 5 min), a jammed hop said again after retry_s up to max_retries, BAI within bai_depth_m of the front, a post officer's traits moving a decision by at most trait_bound, an alert pool committed below commit_risk of expected loss, a post's cover of a low flight (low_cover of its reach), the spread of a FAC's and a pilot's report (fac_sigma_m, report_sigma_m), hunters told within hunter_reach_m and flights diverted within divert_reach_m of a reported place, our listeners' chance (intercept, times 1 - the faction's opsec) within intercept_reach_m of the battery, a methodical officer's wait for a second report (second_report_h, second_report_m), the corps' refusal of a CAS divert (army_refusal) and a FAC's requests per hour with our troops in sight (fac_request_per_h). The posts, their authority, hops' times and alert shares are the factions' "c2" blocks, with their sources. Roadmap S2 (the command live in the session): live_mode 1 the posts' orders into a session's flights, recalls, posts struck by our fires, the nomination cycle, our jamming of the enemy's nets and the strike's clearance, 0 as before (a save without the key replays with it); a package recalled when its target, claimed destroyed since it took off, is believed below recall_live alive; the share of a hop's tries our jamming takes at a strong and a weak J/S (jam_strong_share, jam_weak_share, FM 34-40-7's capture and weak thresholds in comms_jam.*); a post fixed by our direction finding after post_fix_calls heard calls, struck by our fires with post_strike_per_h a hour, hit when the fix is within post_footprint_m; a close support flight in a session asks its FAC for the mark within fac_contact_m of him.

opportunity.source: game value bounded by docs/research/air_battle_2026-11/opportunity.md: identify_s from fm_100_2_1_1984 (identification 3-6 s after detection); decision_s, roll_in_s, roll_out_s and min_release_m from nwc_tp6005_1978 (a 1 s decision, 0.5 s roll-in, 1 s roll-out, 3,000 ft minimum release); misidentify_* and claim_* shaped by afmag_2000_kosovo and the overclaims of docs/air_battle/06_OPPORTUNITY.md section 7 (design reference)
opportunity.notes: Targets of opportunity (simcore/air_war/opportunity.hpp, attack_pass.hpp, opportunity_session.hpp, roadmap B6). mode: 3 as 2, and a load fragged to its flight's target is owed to it wherever the target lies, inside the session or beyond its circle (docs/air_battle/06_OPPORTUNITY.md section 3.4: a planned strike keeps its weapons for its primary; a save made with mode 2 replays with a release beyond the circle leaving the load free), 2 the chain, flown passes and bombs on what is found (roadmap S4: a fixed-wing aircraft's bombs not owed to its target, one pass in a dive of bomb_dive_deg released at delivery.dive_release_m over the ground, the MiG-27's dive delivery of mig27_book; a save made with mode 1 replays without the bombs), 1 the chain and flown passes, 0 before it (a save made before B6 replays with it). A flight leader runs his chain every tick_s on his flight's merged picture (sightings within merge_m the same thing, those below min_confidence not yet acted on): identification takes a log-normal time about identify_s (spread identify_spread), shorter for an easy type and a calm skilled pilot; a target is too close to attack when the decision, the roll-in and the tracking at the flight's speed leave less than min_release_m or the delivery's own release range; at day misidentify_day, at night misidentify_night, the leader takes the wrong thing. The Pact free-hunts only in its plan's zone once its phase holds the air (c2.free_hunt); a flight on a time on target or an escort's slot has slot_slack_s to spare. gun_burst_under_fire: a gun pass under fire (threat seen firing within threat_radius_m for threat_age_s) has this share of its effect. A re-attack separates reattack_separation_m and comes back reattack_heading_deg off the first heading, at most max_passes passes; the leader weighs it at reattack_risk times the first pass's risk. The faction's tendency is moved by the officer's traits by at most trait_bound and by the pilots by at most pilot_bound. Claims: a pass that hit nothing is claimed a kill at claim_on_miss_day (night claim_on_miss_night), and a pass that killed claims claim_extra_* more on average. report_sigma_m: the spread of a pilot's place for a target. A pass is set up run_in_m out, lines up on what is really there within find_m of where he believed it (nothing there: it hits nothing), recovered recover_m past the aim, each wingman trail_m further back. The abstract level: a flight finds a mover with the column chance times a0_find_scale times its type's ease, removes a0_column_hit of a column's function per aircraft, and loses one at a0_column_guns.

route.source: game value: the route planner's (docs/air_battle/01_ROUTES.md sections 6 and 10); continuous_s from crawford_1977_rand (exposure held to 20 s badly degraded mobile defences); egress_clear_s from fm_100_2_1_1984 p. 12-8 (out of the target area in 10 s)
route.notes: Routes as flown (simcore/air_war/route_planner.hpp, roadmap B2). mode: 0 the old four shapes (a save made before B2 replays with it), 1 the route planner, 2 roadmap S7 (a save made before S7 replays with 1): a gate with no feature within a leg joined to its nearest features however far; our believed air bases a cost (a ring of fighter_reach_m, fighter_weight times the front's friendly_fighters and the belief, fighter_low_share of it for a low flight or a helicopter); on a theatre without a map the lattice at fallback_grid2_m and run_in_headings_nomap headings; in a played raid each flight drifts between its fixes by its faction's navigation drift_share, never more than nav_fix_m off a fix (a crew that sees its feature turns over it); the routes as flown back from a session for the rest of the raid. All S7 values game values (docs/air_battle/01_ROUTES.md, As built S7). The graph: map features within corridor_share of the way's length (at least corridor_min_m) of the line gate-target and target-exits, at most max_features, each joined to its neighbours nearest between min_leg_turns turn radii (turn_bank_deg) and max_leg_m, turns of at most max_turn_deg; a feature flown over within straight_deg of straight on is no turn point; features within simplify_m of a straight line between the route's points are left out of them. A leg costs its time, more off the goal's heading (final_cone_m), plus the faction's w_exp x believed lethal seconds in sight (masked by the ground at low level, the site's antenna mask_antenna_m up), w_cont x seconds of one sight past continuous_s, w_low x seconds above the corridor's lowest ground per 100 m. reuse_penalty_s: a feature of the covered route for the other flank, of the way in for the way home. direct_exposure_share: the direct variant's exposure weight. prune_ratio: the other flank dropped when it costs this many times the covered route. corridor_suppression: the corps' suppression of radars within corridor_halfwidth_m of a NATO gate where our troops stand within land_front_m of it. Helicopters: a holding area helo_holding_m behind the gate, a battle position hidden at helo_hide_agl_m and seeing the target at helo_popup_agl_m (hide_penalty_s if not); the Pact scores a target beyond helo_umbrella_m from the front at helo_beyond_umbrella.

hot_phase.source: game value: the switches of roadmaps B11 and S5 (docs/air_battle/10_FACTIONS.md sections 7-9, 13); currency_reference_h: NATO's guide of 15 hours a month (hansard_1981_nato_hours); sortie_h a game value
hot_phase.notes: The hot phase (simcore/air_war/hot_phase.hpp). mode: 2 roadmap S5's: played flights read their faction's initiative, plan adherence, turn back, emission discipline, reaction delay, husbanding and the leader's acts (the raid builder writes them, moved by the officer and the pilot), the package's nerve is 0.1 + 0.5 x its leader's press_on less husbanding x the day's losses over the tolerance (section 9.3, the abstract resolver and the played raid alike), the chatterbox's and silent runner's weights are section 8.5's (tier_weight_mode1 before), and a flight's pilots carry their squadron's combat sorties and their currency (hours in the last year over currency_reference_h, each sortie sortie_h); 1 before it (a save made before S5 replays with it). 1 roadmap B11's planning (NATO's strike and armed reconnaissance offered medium altitude only once the believed working defences fall below the template's medium_below_iads, the phases' new shares, the quirks' new weights); 0 before it, the phases' apportion_mode0 and the quirks' tier_weight_mode0 (a save made before B11 replays with it). The faction values, the officers' and pilots' shifts and the gates are each faction's hot_phase block, not tuning.

damage.source: game values (roadmap S4), the heavy share after data/gameplay/damage.json (a missile's kill heavy 25%, the guns' heavy hits); the repair after affdl_tr_77_115's kill severities and the faction's damaged_return_h
damage.notes: A damaged aircraft back in service (air_war/campaign.hpp): mode 1 by its level, a heavily damaged one heavy_repair_factor times its faction's damaged_return_h, a moderately damaged one damaged_return_h; a played session's damaged aircraft that got away on their own flights with their levels (mission_bridge.hpp), the abstract resolver's drawn heavy at heavy_share by a keyed draw; 0 as before S4 (every one damaged_return_h on a flight drawn; a save without the key replays with it).

air_fight.source: game value: the switch of roadmap S3 (docs/air_battle/07_AIR_TO_AIR.md section 9, docs/air_war/09_BALANCE.md section 20)
air_fight.notes: The abstract air fight in detail (air_war/air_fight.hpp). mode 1: a beam attack's shots from the target's beam, a slash by the side that fired first one pass after which only air_combat.json's a0_slash_return come back, a turning doctrine's fight a0_turn_rounds longer, a fighter dragging a radar round from beyond sight at a0_drag of his skill, strikers that saw the shot answering with flares or chaff if their type carries them in the war's year. 0 before it (a save without the key replays with it). The played session's fight has its own switch, the scenario's air_fight.mode.

balance.source: game value: the switch of roadmap B14 (docs/air_war/09_BALANCE.md section 17)
balance.notes: The balance pass (roadmap B14). mode: 1 its changes: an airborne flight diverted by a post has its new task no sooner than its faction's retask delay (hot_phase.hpp RetaskAirS) after the decision; in the abstract air fight the strikers' abort is drawn at its own rate, a package under an E-3A that sees our fighters coming is not surprised, and the E-3A brings its fighters to the fight by air_combat.json's a0_awacs_meet. 0 before it (a save made before B14 replays with it): the order's hops alone, the abort as a share of abort and press on, the surprise as before and a0_awacs_meet_mode0.

own_air.source: game value: the switch of roadmap S1 (docs/air_battle/08_OUR_FIGHTERS.md, As built (S1))
own_air.notes: Our fighters in the campaign (roadmap S1). mode: 1 our pairs in the played raids beside the package's own fighters, the corridors the enemy learns and times raids into, our defences' holding of fire there, the fighter regiments' reports, NATO's own belt; 0 as before S1 (a save made before S1 loads with it and replays as played).

air_front.source: game values (docs/fronts/02_AIR_FRONT.md sections 2 and 6, track F)
air_front.notes: The fronts (simcore/air_war/front_line.hpp, air_front.hpp; track F). station_m: the line of contact's stations along each theatre front's line, each holding how far the line has moved into our country (all zero until the ground war, F3.3, moves them). step_m: the enemy's air front moves by this step, and the believed cover a sector is weighed by is over a band this deep beyond its air front (F2.2). The switch, air_front.mode, comes with the air front's decision (F2.3); until then the code's 0, at which nothing of it is built or measured.

light.source: game value: the switch of roadmap S8 (docs/LIGHT.md section 5)
light.notes: The light in the air war (roadmap S8). mode: 1 the tuned theatre (theatre_pannonia.json, its "dated_from_light_mode": 1) dated 15 October 1985, its parts of the day by the sun at its origin, and every theatre's light thresholds read from data/gameplay/light.json; 0 as before S8 (a save made before it has no key and replays with it): the tuned theatre undated, its fixed buckets, the code's light defaults.
